title: Endorsement and Servicing of a Travel Protection Plans Certificate
content:
Cover on a Travel Protection Plans certificate is upgraded only when the underwriting desk has already recorded an approved cover upgrade against this policy. The authority is the underwriting desk's own record of the request, read against the reference of that request; a traveller's account of having been promised an upgrade is not that record.

An upgrade is available only on a plan that permits it and only inside the plan's upgrade window counted from issue. Outside the window the traveller buys a second policy instead.

Adding an insured traveller is an amendment and re-rates the whole certificate, because the age loading follows the oldest traveller named.

## Clauses no longer in force

The clause providing that "An increase in the declared trip cost is accepted only up to the plan's ceiling" is **no longer in force**; the ceiling a corrected declared trip cost is held to is settled on the current basis for such a correction and not by this note. That a trip whose cost has grown beyond the plan's ceiling is upgraded to a higher plan rather than amended remains the case.

The clause providing that "No amendment is accepted once the journey has begun or once a claim has been filed, because the risk is then no longer uncertain." is **no longer in force**; when a correction may be carried onto a certificate is settled on the current basis and not by this note.

The clause providing that "A declared particular of the risk may be corrected while the policy stands, and the premium follows the correction from the day it takes effect." is **no longer in force**; the standing in which a certificate may be corrected, and the day a correction takes effect for premium purposes, are settled on the current basis and not by this note.

The clauses that remain above stand as clauses in force, and the plan figures this note reads — whether the plan permits an upgrade, the plan's upgrade window and the plan's ceiling for the declared trip cost — are valid as scheduled.

## The authority for an upgrade

| What is asserted | What is required |
| --- | --- |
| The traveller wishes to be upgraded | Nothing follows from the wish alone |
| The traveller says an upgrade was agreed | Not sufficient; the desk's own record decides |
| An approved cover upgrade stands recorded against this policy | The condition for upgrading cover is met |

A further test stands beside that authority: the plan must permit an upgrade at all, and the request must fall inside the plan's upgrade window counted from issue. Where the window has run, the answer is a second policy rather than an upgrade of the first.
